transcript: Speaker A: I mash the potatoes. I move the masher around in circles. I'm using a masher. I crush. Crush means press very hard. I break it. I mix. Mix means put together. I combine things. I slice. Slice means cut into thin pieces. I stir. Stir means move in circles. I use a spoon. I bake. Bake means cook in an oven. I use heat. I boil. Boil means very hot water. The water bubbles. I serve. Serve means give food. I put it on the table.
